EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: WEG/LAN/L1/ACQ/42

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/Servitude which is required for the public purpose mentioned below.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Land depicted in the survey plan bearing No. P. P. MR/2615, situated in the village of Midigama in Grama Niladari divisions of Midigama East in Divisional Secretary’s division of Weligama, Matara district. This acquisition is made for the distribution of lands among landless people.

Details of lands are described in the annexure. 1. Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Lehuwalawaththehena, Berawamullehena, Lehuwalawatta; Present use of Land: Home garden and shrub jungle. Mixed crop cultivation consisted of 30 coconut trees, 04 Jak trees, 05 Kithul trees between 50-100 years old, Tile roofed permanent building, toilet, water tank, well and cement plastered staircase; Name and Address of the Claimant: Part of Lot No. F 100

of P. P. 454, Original Claimants: R. Jayawardena of ‘Ashoka’ Habaraduwa, K. Jayawardena of Lahuwalawatta, Pitiduwa Road, Weligama, D. Jayawardena of ‘Rivisamaya’ Kolinjadiya, Wennappuwa, M. Jayawardena of Nelumgama, Nelumwewa, Badulla, G. Jayawardena of Godakanda, Pilana, Wanchawala, A. Jayawardena of ‘Sandagiri’ Egodahenawatta, Thalpe, D. Jayawardena of Usruppawatta, Pitiduwa Road, Weligama and A. Jayawardena of No. 22/5, Dumbara Mawatha, Balagolla, Kengalla; Extent: 1.6883 Hectares.

2. Lot No. 2 Name of the land: Lehuwalawaththehena, Berawamullehena, Lehuwalawatta; Present use of land: Home garden and shrub jungle. Mixed crop cultivation consisted of 04 coconut trees, 03 Badi Del trees, 05 Kithul trees between 50-100 years old. Name and Address of the Claimant: R. Jayawardena of ‘Ashoka’ Habaraduwa, K. Jayawardena of Lahuwalawatta, Pitiduwa Road, Weligama, D. Jayawardena of ‘Rivisamaya’ Kolinjadiya, Wennappuwa, M. Jayawardena of Nelumgama, Nelumwewa, Badulla, G. THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: GANA/4/5/Acquisition/82. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/15/2012/VE/285.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude for a public purpose:-
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired: Six allotments of land described below and depicted in the plan No. FVP 528, sheet No. 100 drawn by the
Surveyor General and situated in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 219 D Aluthwatte in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Gangaboda Paththuwa North—Nagoda in Galle District.
1. Lot No. 1625 Name of the land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Scrub jungle and six permanent buildings; Claimant: Watawala Plantation Ltd; Extent: 0.2371 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 1626 Name of the land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Stream; Claimant: Watawala Plantation Ltd; Extent: 0.0023 Hectare.

4. Lot No. 1628 Name of the land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Road; Claimant: Watawala Plantation Ltd; Extent: 0.0172 Hectare.
5. Lot No. 1629 Name of the land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Scrub jungle and 4 permanent buildings and one temporary structure; Claimant: Watawala Plantation Ltd; Extent: 3.5975 Hectares.
6. Lot No. 1630 Name of the land: Nakiyadeniya Estate; Description: Road; Claimant: Watawala Plantation Ltd; Extent: 0.2146 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude are hereby requested to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Nagoda Divisional Secretariat on the 02nd day of March 2016 at 10.30 a.m. and are requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 09th day of February 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
SHANIKA THRIMANNA, Divisional Secretary, Nagoda. Divisional Secretariat, Nagoda, 06th January, 2016. 02-358
